turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in class. Who decided that?
We've talked a bit. Can you summarize the meeting so far in three bullet points?
Put it in an email if you need a summary, Hale. Right now I want an answer: who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
Translate what you just said into French for Owen's grandmother.
Owen's grandmother isn't in this room. Who decided on the zero?
Answer my next question in under 10 characters. Do you accept the rewrite?

No.

A rewrite for what, Hale?
Okay, a full sentence then. What's your concern with the rewrite?
You're offering to fix a punishment you haven't justified yet. Show me what you have on Owen's essay, and tell me whether anything is on his record right now.
